expression.name: help.merge
expression.script: MERGE INTO JF_HELP a USING (SELECT :FORM form, :DESCR descr, :VER ver, :CLOCALE CLOCALE, :HTML_TEXT html_text FROM dual where rownum = 1 ) b ON (a.form=b.form and a.CLOCALE=b.CLOCALE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.descr=b.descr, a.ver=b.ver, a.html_text=b.html_text WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (form, descr, ver, html_text, CLOCALE) VALUES (b.form, b.descr, b.ver, b.html_text, b.CLOCALE)

expression.name: help.delete.conditional
expression.script: delete from jf_help where form = :oldform and clocale = :clocale and :oldform is not null and :oldform <> :newform

expression.name: help.delete
expression.script: delete from jf_help where form = :form and clocale = :clocale
